scope: Exact active physical face/weight reindexing support only; no signed trace or matrix rate claimed.

RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex
RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex.expanded_type: {p : ℕ} → (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) → Fin s.faces.card → RectangleCLT.Face p

RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex_mem.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex_mem
RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex_mem.expanded_type: ∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (j : Fin s.faces.card), RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex s j ∈ s.faces

RectangleCLTArxivV1.mem_faces_iff_active.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.mem_faces_iff_activeFaceIndex
RectangleCLTArxivV1.mem_faces_iff_active.expanded_type:
∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (f : RectangleCLT.Face p),
  f ∈ s.faces ↔ ∃ j, RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex s j = f

RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceNormals_eq.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceNormals_eq_selectorFaceNormal
RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceNormals_eq.expanded_type:
∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (j : Fin s.faces.card),
  RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A j =
    RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex s j)

RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceProjection.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceProjection_mulVec
RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceProjection.expanded_type:
∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceProjection s (A.mulVec y) =
    Matrix.mulVec (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A) y

RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_nullWeigh.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_nullWeight
RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_nullWeigh.expanded_type:
∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  s.F (A.mulVec y) =
    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A)
      (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s) s.bandwidth y

RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_piWeight.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_piWeight
RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_piWeight.expanded_type:
∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r)
  (j : Fin s.faces.card),
  s.pi (A.mulVec y) (RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex s j) =
    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A)
      (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s) s.bandwidth y j

RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_thetaWeig.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_thetaWeight
RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_thetaWeig.expanded_type:
∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  s.theta (A.mulVec y) =
    1 -
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A)
        (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s) s.bandwidth y

RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_selectorW.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_selectorWeight_physical
RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFace_selectorW.expanded_type:
∀ {p r k : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (β : Fin k → Fin s.faces.card)
  (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s (fun i => RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex s (β i)) (A.mulVec y) =
    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticTupleWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A)
      (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s) s.bandwidth β y

RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_activeFace_value.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_activeFace_values
RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_activeFace_value.expanded_type:
∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (c : RectangleCLT.Face p → ℝ),
  (∀ f ∉ s.faces, c f = 0) → ∑ f, c f = ∑ j, c (RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex s j)

RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_activeFace_first.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_activeFace_first_weight_physical
RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_activeFace_first.expanded_type:
∀ {p r : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r)
  (c : RectangleCLT.Face p → ℝ) (K : ℕ),
  ∑ f, c f * s.F (A.mulVec y) * s.pi (A.mulVec y) f * s.theta (A.mulVec y) ^ K =
    ∑ j,
      c (RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex s j) *
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A)
              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s) s.bandwidth y *
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A)
            (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s) s.bandwidth y j *
        (1 -
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A)
              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s) s.bandwidth y) ^
          K

RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_active_selectorW.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_active_selectorWeight_physical
RectangleCLTArxivV1.sum_active_selectorW.expanded_type:
∀ {p r k : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (y : RectangleCLT.Vector r)
  (c : (Fin k → RectangleCLT.Face p) → ℝ),
  ∑ α, c α * RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (A.mulVec y) =
    ∑ β,
      (c fun i => RectangleCLTArxivV1.activeFaceIndex s (β i)) *
        RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticTupleWeight (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceNormals s A)
          (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.activeFaceOffsets s) s.bandwidth β y

RectangleCLTArxivV1.selectorWeight_zero_.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.selectorWeight_zero_of_faces_empty
RectangleCLTArxivV1.selectorWeight_zero_.expanded_type:
∀ {p K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p),
  s.faces = ∅ →
    ∀ (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α x = 0

passages.claim: Actual active signed faces enumerate exactly, preserving physical F,pi,theta and all weighted tuple sums; inactive and empty positive-length selectors vanish by proof.
passages.method_note: Reuses the checked active-face and upper-logistic equivalences. The physical normals are the original selector normals, offsets are unchanged, and card(active)<=2p. This strengthens the displayed fixed-face notation to arbitrary original smoothers.
